title: Finalize P1-005 V2 runtime contract and evidence integrity
businessObjective: Fully finalize V2 runtime policy contract evaluation, schema validation integrity, anti-exploit defenses, and superseding evidence for P1-005.
technicalObjective: Require V2 contract for runtime decisions, mandate all V2 contextual policy fields in schema, enforce strict schema loading/keyword validation, compare context directly against V2 policy authority fields, expand negative test suite to 60+ cases, and bind reconciliation evidence to exact commit SHAs.
assumptions: No production, staging, database, migration, credential, or external-service access is authorized.
P1-005 runtime evaluator evaluates strictly against V2 policy contract artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/policy-engine/src/evaluator.mjs accepts ONLY V2 policy contract (schemaVersion 2.0.0) for runtime evaluation.

schemas/authorization-policy-contract.schema.json requires targetAction, principalClass, resourceClass, dataClassification, tenantScopeRequired, approvalRequired, defaultEffect, and evaluatorMode on every V2 policy object.
evaluatePolicy fails closed with SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED if policy, context, or decision schemas are missing, invalid, or contain unsupported keywords.

packages/policy-engine/src/json-schema-evaluator.mjs enforces a closed supported-keyword subset ($schema, $id, title, type, const, enum, required, properties, additionalProperties, minLength) and rejects unsupported schema keywords.
packages/policy-engine/src/evaluator.mjs compares requestContext fields directly against the matched V2 policy object fields as the actual decision authority.

tests/policy-engine/validate-deterministic-policy-evaluator.mjs includes explicit tests for schema omission/corruption, unsupported keywords, V2 field omissions, V1 runtime rejection, request mutations, and decision schema malformations.
evidence/tasks/SUT-AIOS-P1-005/reconciliation.md is updated with repository-relative links and exact commit SHAs.
solEscalationTriggers: Any live evaluation engine, database, migration, RLS, credential, or production-write scope.
rollbackExpectations: Revert schema, evaluator, CI workflow, task-state record, and evidence together; retain historical evidence.
